content.value: . Suppose a house owner has 3 cows and 4 buffalos. Each cow and buffalos is producing dung about 7 kg/day and 12 kg/day, respectively.
(i) By using the dung obtained from the above information in a biogas plant, how much energy can be produced per day?

(ii) Suppose the house owner has three bulbs of 40 watt and one fan of 80 watt. Is it possible to supply the required electrical energy needed for running the bulbs and fan from the biogas plant if 65% of the energy is lost during the transmission? [Gas production per kg of dung = 0.04 rrr']
